entries.summary: 3-bit is where the agentic behaviour goes. With 10B active parameters spread over 256 experts, routing decisions are made on a small slice of the model, and 3-bit quantization blurs exactly that slice — malformed tool arguments and dropped call sequences show up well before the prose reads worse.

mitigations.note: The 76.5GB 4-bit build is the one to run; it fits a 96GB machine with context to spare, which is the whole argument for this model over the 397B.
Grammar-constrained tool schemas recover much of the malformed-argument loss.

entries.summary: Every score here is Alibaba's own, published on release day and not independently replicated in this dataset. The claim that a 122B model lands within a few points of a 397B one is the interesting part and the part most in need of outside confirmation. Long-context and factuality cells are blank rather than estimated — no RULER or hallucination result exists for it.

mitigations.note: A caveat on the evidence, not on the model.
